name: ShapeBlur-TS-TW

frames.best_why: Frame 2 has the largest, clearest blur plume swelling from the top-right corner.

tagline: A rounded square outline smears into a soft plume under the pointer.
summary: A thin white rounded-square frame on black grows a smoky grey bloom wherever the pointer hovers, the glow sliding along the outline with a damped lag.
appearance: A single crisp rounded-square outline, one thin white stroke, centred on black. Near the pointer the line breaks into a broad soft grey plume that fades outward.
behaviour: The pointer drags a blurred bulge along the square's edge, its brightness falling off with distance from the cursor. When the pointer leaves, the outline draws clean again.
search_phrases: blurred glow on a rounded square
hover blur effect on a frame
use_when: A minimal hero needs a quiet shape that still reacts to the pointer.
avoid_when: It is a full-screen WebGL canvas, so it needs a sized parent and costs GPU time even at rest.
customise: Variation (rounded square, circle, ring or triangle), pixel ratio, shape size, roundness, border size and the hover circle's size and edge are props.
weight_why: A single full-screen shader quad redrawn every frame, with a damped pointer position.

a11y.note: Decorative with nothing to operate; it needs a pointer and does not check reduced-motion preferences.

issues: The demo has no focal content, so the component is only a bare outline on black.
Pointer tracking listens on the whole document, so the plume moves even outside the canvas.
polish_why: The blur is smooth and restrained; alone on black it reads as a thin demo.
